questions.question: Which of the following is a function of the Physical layer?

options.B: Bit synchronization and bit rate control
options.C: Flow control of frames using MAC addresses

questions.explanation: The Physical layer maintains the physical connection and handles bit synchronization, bit rate control, topology and transmission modes.

questions.question: The process of deriving meaningful information from a large amount of data is called:
questions.explanation: Data mining discovers useful patterns and knowledge in large datasets; a data warehouse only stores integrated data for analysis.

questions.concept: Array static vs linked list dynamic
questions.question: In ____, memory is assigned at compile time, and in ____, memory is assigned at runtime.
questions.explanation: A static array's size is fixed when the program is compiled, while linked list nodes are allocated dynamically at runtime as needed.

questions.question: A function in which the number of minterms equals the number of maxterms is called a:
questions.explanation: A function whose number of minterms equals its number of maxterms (each 2^(n-1) for n variables) is called a neutral function. Every self-dual function is neutral, but a neutral function need not be self-dual, so 'self-dual' does not define this property.

questions.question: A major disadvantage of mask ROM is that:

options.A: It loses its data when power is switched off
options.B: It has an extremely short life and needs frequent replacement
options.C: It cannot be reprogrammed if the stored data needs to be changed
options.D: It can be erased only with ultraviolet light

questions.explanation: Mask ROM data is fixed during chip fabrication, so it cannot be reprogrammed; changes require manufacturing new chips.

questions.question: Multimedia is best defined as:

options.A: The integration of different types of media such as text, images, audio, video and animation
options.B: A type of computer memory used for graphics
options.C: A single medium used to store large files
options.D: A network protocol used for streaming

questions.explanation: Multimedia is the integration of several media types such as text, drawings, still images, video, audio and animation.

questions.question: Which command is used to find the IP address corresponding to a domain name using DNS?
questions.explanation: nslookup queries DNS servers to resolve domain names to IP addresses; arp maps IP to MAC addresses.

questions.question: A complete computer on a single chip is called a:
questions.explanation: A microcontroller integrates CPU, memory (RAM/ROM) and I/O on one chip; a microprocessor contains only the CPU.

questions.question: Which statement is correct?

options.A: Deep learning is a technique that only mimics human behaviour without data
options.B: AI is a subset of deep learning that uses neural networks
options.C: Machine learning makes multi-layer neural networks feasible, and DL uses only statistics
options.D: Machine learning uses statistical methods to enable machines to improve with experience

questions.explanation: AI mimics human behaviour; ML is a subset of AI using statistical methods to improve with experience; DL is a subset of ML that makes multi-layer neural network computation feasible.

questions.question: What is the best-case time complexity of (optimized) bubble sort when the input is already sorted?
questions.explanation: With a swap flag, bubble sort finishes after one pass with no swaps on sorted input, giving O(n). Average and worst cases are O(n^2).

questions.question: What is the full form of RTP, the protocol used in video conferencing and live streaming?
questions.explanation: RTP stands for Real-Time Transport Protocol; it carries real-time audio and video, e.g. in Zoom and Skype calls.

questions.question: Which join returns all rows from the left table and only the matching rows from the right table?
questions.explanation: A left outer join keeps every row of the left table and fills NULL where the right table has no match.

questions.question: Operating systems running on mainframe computers that serve hundreds of terminal users at once are of which type?
questions.explanation: Mainframe OSes serve many users and many jobs simultaneously, making them multi-user, multi-tasking.

questions.question: Which Boolean law is expressed by A + B = B + A?
questions.explanation: The commutative law states that the order of operands does not change the result: A + B = B + A.

questions.question: Repeatedly and intensively testing one particular module over and over, which is tedious and frustrating, is called:
questions.explanation: Gorilla testing hammers a single module repetitively to check its robustness; monkey testing is random testing.

questions.question: According to Boolean algebra, A + 1 = ?
questions.explanation: By the annulment (null) law of OR, anything ORed with 1 gives 1, so A + 1 = 1.

questions.question: How many necessary conditions must hold simultaneously for a deadlock to occur?
questions.explanation: The four Coffman conditions are mutual exclusion, hold and wait, no preemption and circular wait.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of secondary (external) memory?
questions.explanation: Blu-ray Disc is external/secondary storage, like hard disks, CDs, DVDs, pen drives and memory cards; SRAM, DRAM and EEPROM are primary memory.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a constraint in SQL?
questions.explanation: PRIMARY KEY, NOT NULL and CHECK are column/table constraints. UNION is a set operator that combines the results of two SELECT queries.

questions.question: Which algorithm design technique is used in quick sort?
questions.explanation: Quick sort partitions the array around a pivot and recursively sorts the sub-arrays, which is divide and conquer.

questions.question: When the number of iterations is known beforehand, which loop is most suitable?
questions.explanation: A for loop is used when we know how many times the loop body needs to run.

questions.question: A logo must look perfectly sharp whether printed on a visiting card or a large banner. Which graphics type is most suitable?
questions.explanation: No matter how much you zoom in on a vector image, its lines and curves remain smooth, so vectors are used for logos. Raster/bitmap images become pixelated when enlarged.

questions.question: Which keyword exits a function and sends a value back to the caller?
questions.explanation: return ends the function and returns a value to the caller.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a cloud service model?
questions.explanation: The service models are IaaS, PaaS and SaaS; hybrid cloud is a deployment model.

questions.question: What is the primary function of routing in the network layer?

options.A: Finding the best path for data

questions.explanation: Routing selects the best path for packets from source to destination across networks; framing is a data link function.
